# William's Auto Detailing

> Top-rated mobile car detailing and ceramic coating service based in Doral, FL, serving all of Miami-Dade County. We come to your home, office, or apartment. 5.0 stars on Google with 180+ reviews.

- Phone: (808) 772-0952
- Email: williamautodetailing@gmail.com
- Base: Doral, FL — mobile service across Miami-Dade County
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/william.autodetailing/

## Services

- [Detail Packages](https://williamautodetailing.net/detail-packages): Signature Detail (complete interior & exterior maintenance, ~2 hrs), Pristine Detail (deep clean & exterior restoration, ~3 hrs), The Perfect Detail (paint correction + deepest clean, ~4–5 hrs)
- [Ceramic Coating](https://williamautodetailing.net/ceramic-coating): Tier 1 Ceramic Coating (2–3 year protection), Tier 2 Gyeon Certified Coating (5 year protection), Windshield Ceramic (18 months)
- [Interior Detailing](https://williamautodetailing.net/services/interior-detailing): Air purge, two-stage vacuum, seat shampoo & extraction, leather conditioning, streak-free glass
- [Exterior Detailing](https://williamautodetailing.net/services/exterior-detailing): Foam bath hand wash, wheels & tires, clay bar, iron removal, up to 6 months ceramic sealant
- [Paint Correction](https://williamautodetailing.net/services/paint-correction): Machine polishing to remove swirls and light scratches and restore gloss
- [Shampoo & Extraction](https://williamautodetailing.net/services/shampoo-extraction): Shampoo & extraction of upholstery, carpets and mats with stain treatment — $75, ~1 hr
- [Leather & Alcantara Cleaning](https://williamautodetailing.net/services/leather-alcantara-cleaning): Deep clean & conditioning, UV protection up to 3 months — $75, ~30 min
- [Headlight Restoration](https://williamautodetailing.net/services/headlight-restoration): Restores clarity, 3 year UV coating — $90, ~1 hr
- [Engine Bay Detail](https://williamautodetailing.net/services/engine-bay-detail): Clean, protect and dress the engine bay — $50
- [Add-Ons](https://williamautodetailing.net/add-ons): Extra services that can be added to any detail
- [Gallery](https://williamautodetailing.net/gallery): Before & after photos of our work
- [Book an Appointment](https://williamautodetailing.net/book): Get a quote and schedule a mobile detail
